name: venceu
description: Venceu — lembretes de vencimento, cobranças e assistente virtual por WhatsApp e e-mail.

scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.check:netlify: esbuild netlify/functions/api.mts netlify/functions/automacao.mts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --external:pg-native --outdir=.netlify-check --log-level=warning && rm -rf .netlify-check && node scripts/check-netlify-runtime.mjs
